summary: CDW LLC and CDW Finance Corporation, with parent CDW Corporation as guarantor, entered an underwriting agreement dated September 14, 2026 for a registered public offering of $1.5 billion of senior notes: $600 million 5.700% due 2029, $500 million 6.100% due 2032, and $400 million 6.350% due 2033. BofA, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho and Wells Fargo are representatives of the underwriters. Expected closing is September 21, 2026, subject to customary conditions, under an effective Form S-3ASR shelf. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no equity or change-of-control terms apply.
